title: Two-Factor Field
summary: A 3 × 2 factorial ANOVA: cell means, main effects and the interaction, Type III tests like SPSS with afex, partial η² and an interaction plot.
hints: Cell means: `group_by(programme, experience) |> summarise(n = n(), mean = mean(efficacy_t2), .groups = "drop")`.
`aov(efficacy_t2 ~ programme * experience, data = pd)` fits both main effects and the interaction. afex: `aov_car(efficacy_t2 ~ programme * experience + Error(id), data = pd)`.
`eta_squared(fit2, partial = TRUE)`. The plot: `ggplot(cells, aes(x = programme, y = mean, colour = experience, group = experience)) + geom_point() + geom_line()`.
